448 static void *DPC_ObjDet_MemPoolAlloc(MemPoolObj *pool,
449  uint32_t size,
450  uint8_t align)
451 {
452  void *retAddr = NULL;
453  uintptr_t addr;
454 
455  addr = CSL_MEM_ALIGN(pool->currAddr, align);
456  if ((addr + size) <= ((uintptr_t)pool->cfg.addr + pool->cfg.size))
457  {
458  retAddr = (void *)addr;
459  pool->currAddr = addr + size;
460  pool->maxCurrAddr = CSL_MAX(pool->currAddr, pool->maxCurrAddr);
461  }
462 
463  return (retAddr);
464 }

553 static void *DPC_ObjDet_BiDirMemPoolAlloc
554 (
555  BiDirMemPoolObj *pool,
556  uint32_t size,
557  uint8_t align,
558  bool isPersistent
559 )
560 {
561  void *retAddr = NULL;
562  uintptr_t addr;
563 
564  if(isPersistent)
565  {
566  uint32_t availableSize = CSL_MIN(pool->cfg.endSize, pool->cfg.size - pool->maxCurrAddr);
567  if (size <= availableSize)
568  {
569  addr = pool->currBottomAddr - size;
570  if(CSL_MEM_IS_NOT_ALIGN(addr, align))
571  {
572  /* Due to allocation moving towards smaller address, need to reduce the alignment difference
573  * CSL_MEM_ALIGN adds alignment difference, after reducing by align
574  */
575  addr = CSL_MEM_ALIGN(addr - align, align);
576  }
577  if((pool->currBottomAddr - addr) <= availableSize)
578  {
579  retAddr = (void *)addr;
580  pool->currBottomAddr = addr;
581  }
582  }
583  }
584  else
585  {
586  addr = CSL_MEM_ALIGN(pool->currTopAddr, align);
587  if ((addr + size) <= ((uintptr_t)pool->cfg.addr + pool->cfg.size))
588  {
589  retAddr = (void *)addr;
590  pool->currTopAddr = addr + size;
591  pool->maxCurrAddr = CSL_MAX(pool->currTopAddr, pool->maxCurrAddr);
592  }
593  }
594 
595  return (retAddr);
596 }

644 void DPC_ObjectDetection_frameStart(DPM_DPCHandle handle)
645 {
646  ObjDetObj *objDetObj = (ObjDetObj *)handle;
647 
648  objDetObj->stats.frameStartTimeStamp = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
649 #ifdef OBJECTDETHWA_PRINT_DPC_TIMING_INFO
650  gTimingInfo.frameStartTimes[gTimingInfo.frameCnt % OBJECTDETHWA_NUM_FRAME_TIMING_TO_STORE] = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
651  gTimingInfo.frameCnt++;
652 #endif
653 
654 #ifdef SOC_AWR2X44P
655  CSL_dss_rcmRegs *ptrDssRcmRegs = (CSL_dss_rcmRegs *)CSL_CM4_DSS_RCM_U_BASE;
656 
657  if(objDetObj->subFrameObj[0].staticCfg.powerOptCfg.hwaStateAfterFrameProc == DPC_OBJDET_HWA_CG_ENABLE)
658  {
659 
660  ptrDssRcmRegs->DSS_HWA_CLK_GATE = DPC_OBJDET_HWA_CLOCK_UNGATE;
661  }
662 #endif
663 
664  DebugP_logInfo("ObjDet DPC: Frame Start, frameIndx = %d, subFrameIndx = %d\n",
665  objDetObj->stats.frameStartIntCounter, objDetObj->subFrameIndx);
666 
667 #ifdef INCLUDE_DPM
668  /* Perform DPM_notifyExecute only if the previous frame's/subFrame's result has been exported,
669  i.e., the result exported ioctl has been received from the MSS. Otherwise,
670  DPM_notifyExecute will be performed in the result exported ioctl */
671  if (objDetObj->numTimesResultExported == objDetObj->stats.subframeStartIntCounter)
672  {
673  DebugP_assert(DPM_notifyExecute(objDetObj->dpmHandle, handle) == 0);
674  }
675  else
676  {
677  /* Do Nothing */
678  }
679 #else
680  /* Start the DPC Execution for this frame. */
681  SemaphoreP_post (&objDetObj->dpcExecSemHandle);
682 #endif
683 
684  /* Increment interrupt counter for debugging, sync, and reporting purpose */
685  if (objDetObj->subFrameIndx == 0U)
686  {
687  objDetObj->stats.frameStartIntCounter++;
688  }
689 
690  objDetObj->stats.subframeStartIntCounter++;
691 }

704 static uint32_t DPC_ObjDet_GetRangeWinGenLen(DPU_RangeProcHWA_Config *cfg)

731 static void DPC_ObjDet_GenRangeWindow(DPU_RangeProcHWA_Config *cfg)
732 {
733 
734  /* Symmetric window */
735  uint32_t interfMitigWindow[DPC_OBJDET_RANGEPROC_NUM_INTFMITIG_WIN_SIZE_TOTAL >> 1];
736  uint8_t idx;
737 
738  mathUtils_genWindow((uint32_t *)interfMitigWindow,
739  DPC_OBJDET_RANGEPROC_NUM_INTFMITIG_WIN_SIZE_TOTAL,
740  DPC_OBJDET_RANGEPROC_NUM_INTFMITIG_WIN_SIZE_TOTAL >> 1,
741  DPC_DPU_RANGEPROC_INTERFMITIG_WINDOW_TYPE,
742  DPC_OBJDET_QFORMAT_RANGEPROC_INTERFMITIG_WINDOW);
743 
744  /* Only 5 win samples are supported by the HWA */
745  for (idx = 0; idx < DPU_RANGEPROCHWADDMA_NUM_INTFMITIG_WIN_HWACOMMONCFG_SIZE; idx++)
746  {
747  cfg->hwRes.hwaCfg.hwaInterfMitigWindow[DPU_RANGEPROCHWADDMA_NUM_INTFMITIG_WIN_HWACOMMONCFG_SIZE - 1U - idx] =
748  (uint8_t)interfMitigWindow[(DPC_OBJDET_RANGEPROC_NUM_INTFMITIG_WIN_SIZE_TOTAL >> 1U) - 2U - idx];
749  }
750 
751  /* Range FFT window */
752  mathUtils_genWindow((uint32_t *)cfg->staticCfg.window,
753  cfg->staticCfg.ADCBufData.dataProperty.numAdcSamples,
754  DPC_ObjDet_GetRangeWinGenLen(cfg),
755  DPC_DPU_RANGEPROC_FFT_WINDOW_TYPE,
756  DPC_OBJDET_QFORMAT_RANGE_FFT);
757 }

797 static uint32_t DPC_ObjDet_GenDopplerWindow(DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Config *cfg)
798 {
799  uint32_t winType;
800 
801  /* For too small window, force rectangular window to avoid loss of information
802  * due to small window values (e.g. hanning has first and last coefficients 0) */
803  if (cfg->staticCfg.numChirps <= 4U)
804  {
805  winType = MATHUTILS_WIN_RECT;
806  }
807  else
808  {
809  winType = DPC_DPU_DOPPLERPROC_FFT_WINDOW_TYPE;
810  }

997 static inline float DPC_ObjDet_quadInterpAroundPeak(const uint32_t * restrict y)

1002 
1003  ym1 = (float) y[0]; /* y(peak-1) */
1004  y0 = (float) y[1]; /* y(peak) */
1005  yp1 = (float) y[2]; /* y(peak+1) */
1006

1033 static inline void dotpCmplxf(const float * restrict x, const float * restrict y, int nx,
1034  float * restrict re, float * restrict im)
1035 {
1036  int i;
1037  __float2_t x0_im_re, y0_im_re, result0 = 0;
1038  __float2_t x1_im_re, y1_im_re, result1 = 0;
1039  __float2_t x2_im_re, y2_im_re, result2 = 0;
1040  __float2_t x3_im_re, y3_im_re, result3 = 0;
1041  __float2_t result;
1042 
1043  _nassert(nx % 4 == 0);
1044  _nassert(nx > 0);
1045  _nassert((int)x % 8 == 0);
1046  _nassert((int)y % 8 == 0);
1047 
1048  for(i = 0; i < 2 * nx; i += 8)
1049  {
1050  /* load 4 sets of input data */
1051  x0_im_re = _amem8_f2((void*)&x[i]);
1052  y0_im_re = _amem8_f2((void*)&y[i]);
1053 
1054  x1_im_re = _amem8_f2((void*)&x[i+2]);
1055  y1_im_re = _amem8_f2((void*)&y[i+2]);
1056 
1057  x2_im_re = _amem8_f2((void*)&x[i+4]);
1058  y2_im_re = _amem8_f2((void*)&y[i+4]);
1059 
1060  x3_im_re = _amem8_f2((void*)&x[i+6]);
1061  y3_im_re = _amem8_f2((void*)&y[i+6]);
1062 
1063  /* calculate 4 running sums */
1064  result0 = _daddsp(_complex_mpysp(x0_im_re, y0_im_re), result0);
1065  result1 = _daddsp(_complex_mpysp(x1_im_re, y1_im_re), result1);
1066  result2 = _daddsp(_complex_mpysp(x2_im_re, y2_im_re), result2);
1067  result3 = _daddsp(_complex_mpysp(x3_im_re, y3_im_re), result3);
1068  }
1069 
1070  result = _daddsp(_daddsp(result0,result1),_daddsp(result2,result3));
1071  *re = _hif2(result);
1072  *im = _lof2(result);
1073 }
1074 
1077 typedef struct cmplxfImRe_t_
1078 {
1079  float imag;
1080  float real;
1081 } cmplxfImRe_t;
1084 typedef union cmplxfUnion_t_
1085 {
1086  cmplxfImRe_t cmplx;
1087  float dat[2];
1088  double ddat;
1089 }cmplxfUnion_t;
1090 
1092 #define ROUND_UNSIGNED(x) ((x) + 0.5f)
1093 #define AOA_DFT_LEN (128)
1094 /* A simple sin-cos LUT used for the DFT computations in
1095  * DPC_ObjDet_estimateXYZ */
1096 cmplxfImRe_t dftSinCosTable[AOA_DFT_LEN] __attribute__((aligned(8))) = {
1097 #include "cossintable.c"
1098 };
1099 
1116 int32_t DPC_ObjDet_estimateXYZ(SubFrameObj * restrict subFrmObj,
1117  ObjDetObj * restrict objDetObj,
1118  const DetObjParams * restrict detObjList,
1119  DPIF_PointCloudCartesian * restrict objOut,
1120  uint32_t numObjOut,
1121  uint32_t * restrict finalNumObjOut)
1122 {
1123 
1124  uint16_t azimFFTSize = subFrmObj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.staticCfg.numAzimFFTBins;
1125  const float invAzimFFTSize = divsp(1.0f,(float) azimFFTSize);
1126  uint32_t objIdx, sampIdx, idx;
1127  uint32_t maxAzimMaskWidth = 8*sizeof(objDetObj->commonCfg.zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskAzim);
1128  uint32_t maxElevMaskWidth = 8*sizeof(objDetObj->commonCfg.zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskElev);
1129  int32_t currLoc;
1130  float noisedB, signaldB, snrdB;
1131  float peakIdxOffset, peakIdxFlt;
1132  int32_t peakLoc;
1133  float azimSinPhase;
1134  cmplxfUnion_t DFTValAzim, DFTValElev, elevOutput;
1135  float elevSinPhase, elevCosPhase;
1136  float rangeStep, range, dopplerStep, x, ySquared, z;
1137  float wz,peakLocFlt, peakIdxFlt_DFT;
1138  int32_t dopIdx;
1139  uint32_t numDopplerBins = subFrmObj->staticCfg.numDopplerBins;
1140  int16_t ValidObjIdx;
1141 
1142  /* Alignment is to be done because we use the antenna calib params for
1143  * multiplication, using optimized DSP routines, which require a 8 byte alignment */
1144  cmplxfImRe_t samplesCalib[MAX_NUM_VIRT_ANT] __attribute__((aligned(8)));
1145  cmplx32ImRe_t rearrangedAzimSamples[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT] __attribute__((aligned(8)));
1146  cmplx32ImRe_t rearrangedElevSamples[MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT] __attribute__((aligned(8)));
1147 
1148  int32_t retVal = 0;
1149  cmplxfImRe_t dftFactorsAzim[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT] __attribute__((aligned(8)));
1150  cmplxfImRe_t dftFactorsElev[MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT] __attribute__((aligned(8)));
1151  double * azimSamplesCalib = (double *)&samplesCalib[0];
1152  double * elevSamplesCalib = (double *)&samplesCalib[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT];
1153  int64_t * restrict azimSamples;
1154  int64_t * restrict elevSamples;
1155  double samplesFlt2;
1156  double *antennaCalibParams = (double *)&objDetObj->commonCfg.antennaCalibParams[0];
1157 
1158  rangeStep = subFrmObj->staticCfg.rangeStep;
1159  dopplerStep = subFrmObj->staticCfg.dopplerStep;
1160 
1161  /* This variable will index the final object list */
1162  ValidObjIdx = 0;
1163 
1164  for (objIdx = 0; objIdx < numObjOut; objIdx++)
1165  {
1166  /* 1. Interpolate around peak to get fractional estimate of Azimuth index */
1167  peakIdxOffset = DPC_ObjDet_quadInterpAroundPeak(detObjList[objIdx].azimPeakSamples);
1168 
1169  /* Correct peak index with the fractional index*/
1170  peakIdxFlt = (float)detObjList[objIdx].azimIdx + peakIdxOffset;
1171  peakIdxFlt_DFT = peakIdxFlt * (invAzimFFTSize * AOA_DFT_LEN);
1172  peakLoc = ROUND_UNSIGNED(peakIdxFlt_DFT);
1173 
1174 
1175  /* 2a. Calculate DFT Factors corresponding to wx for Row 1.
1176  * i.e. calculate \f$\e^{j wx}\f$
1177  */
1178  idx = 0;
1179  for (sampIdx = 0; sampIdx < maxAzimMaskWidth; sampIdx ++)
1180  {
1181  if((objDetObj->commonCfg.zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskAzim >> sampIdx) & 0x1U)
1182  {
1183  currLoc = (peakLoc*sampIdx)%AOA_DFT_LEN;
1184  dftFactorsAzim[idx++] = dftSinCosTable[currLoc];
1185  }
1186 
1187  /* Break the loop after computing all dft factors in azimuth dimension */
1188  if(idx == MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT)
1189  break;
1190  }
1191 
1192  /* 2b. Calculate DFT Factors corresponding to wx for Row 0.
1193  * i.e. calculate \f$\e^{j wx}\f$
1194  */
1195  idx = 0;
1196  for (sampIdx = 0; sampIdx < maxElevMaskWidth; sampIdx ++)
1197  {
1198  if((objDetObj->commonCfg.zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskElev >> sampIdx) & 0x1U)
1199  {
1200  currLoc = (peakLoc*sampIdx)%AOA_DFT_LEN;
1201  dftFactorsElev[idx++] = dftSinCosTable[currLoc];
1202  }
1203 
1204  /* Break the loop after computing all dft factors in elevation dimension */
1205  if(idx == MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT)
1206  break;
1207  }
1208 
1209  /* 2c. Rearrange the antenna samples according to the virtual antenna mapping. */
1210  for (sampIdx = 0; sampIdx < MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT; sampIdx ++)
1211  {
1212  rearrangedAzimSamples[sampIdx] = detObjList[objIdx].azimSamples[objDetObj->commonCfg.antennaGeometryCfg[sampIdx]];
1213  }
1214 
1215  for (sampIdx = 0; sampIdx < MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT; sampIdx ++)
1216  {
1217  rearrangedElevSamples[sampIdx] = detObjList[objIdx].elevSamples[objDetObj->commonCfg.antennaGeometryCfg[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT+sampIdx]];
1218  }
1219 
1220  azimSamples = (int64_t*) rearrangedAzimSamples;
1221  elevSamples = (int64_t*) rearrangedElevSamples;
1222 
1223  /* 3. Azimuth Antenna Calibration:
1224  * Multiply azimuth samples (azimSamples) of Doppler FFT with antenna calib params (antennaCalibParams)
1225  */
1226 
1227  for (sampIdx = 0; sampIdx < MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT; sampIdx++)
1228  {
1229  samplesFlt2 = _dintsp(azimSamples[sampIdx]);
1230  azimSamplesCalib[sampIdx] = _complex_mpysp(samplesFlt2,antennaCalibParams[sampIdx]);
1231  }
1232 
1233  /* 4. Elevation Antenna calibration
1234  * Multiply elev samples with antenna calib params */
1235  for (sampIdx = MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT; sampIdx < MAX_NUM_VIRT_ANT ; sampIdx++ )
1236  {
1237  samplesFlt2 = _dintsp(elevSamples[sampIdx - MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT]);
1238  elevSamplesCalib[sampIdx-MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT] = _complex_mpysp(samplesFlt2, antennaCalibParams[sampIdx]);
1239  }
1240 
1241  /* 5. Single Bin DFT on the azimuth antennas to estimate phase at peak.
1242  *
1243  \f[
1244  X_{azim} (\omega_x) = \sum_{k=0}^{N_{azim} - 1} azimSample(k) e^{-j k \omega_x}
1245  \f]
1246  * Multiply DFT factors with azimuth of Doppler FFT samples corrected for antenna calibration.
1247  */
1248  dotpCmplxf((float *)&azimSamplesCalib[0], (float *)&dftFactorsAzim[0], MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT, &DFTValAzim.cmplx.real, &DFTValAzim.cmplx.imag);
1249 
1250 
1251  /* 6. Single Bin DFT on the elevation antennas to estimate phase at peak.
1252  *
1253  \f[
1254  X_{elev} (\omega_x) = \sum_{k=0}^{N_{elev} - 1} elevSample(k) e^{-j (k+2) \omega_x}
1255  \f]
1256  * The elevation antennas (essentially the 4 virtual antennas corresponding to the
1257  * elevation offset Tx antenna) are 4 in number and offset by 3 positions from the
1258  * azimuth virtual array. Hence when the DFT is computed, begin from the 3rd DFT parameter.
1259  *
1260  * Both elevSamplesCalib and cosValSinVal[4] are double-word aligned. */
1261  dotpCmplxf((float *)&elevSamplesCalib[0], (float *)&dftFactorsElev[0], MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT, &DFTValElev.cmplx.real, &DFTValElev.cmplx.imag);
1262 
1263  /* 7. Estimate phase difference between the peak location at azimuth antennas and elevation antennas at peak.
1264  * - 1. compute the conjugate product to get the phase difference (i.e. AzimVal * conj(ElevVal)) */
1265  elevOutput.ddat = _complex_conjugate_mpysp (DFTValElev.ddat, DFTValAzim.ddat);
1266 
1267 
1268  /* - 2. Compute the angle of the product to estimate the phase change in elevation.
1269  \f[
1270  \omega_z = angle (\ X_{elev} (\omega_x)' \times X_{azim} (\omega_x) )\
1271  \f]
1272  */
1273  if (fabsf(elevOutput.cmplx.imag) < (0.15f*fabsf(elevOutput.cmplx.real)))
1274  {
1275  // small angle approximation.
1276  wz = divsp(elevOutput.cmplx.imag, elevOutput.cmplx.real);
1277  }
1278  else
1279  {
1280  wz = atan2sp(elevOutput.cmplx.imag, elevOutput.cmplx.real);
1281  if (wz > PI_)
1282  {
1283  wz -= 2.0f*PI_;
1284  }
1285  }
1286 
1287  /* 8. Obtain range using the range resolution and the range Index */
1288  range = rangeStep * (float)detObjList[objIdx].rangeIdx;
1289 
1290  /* 9. Obtain z, x coordinates.
1291  \f[
1292  \Phi = asin(\frac{\omega_z}{2 \pi d_z})
1293  \f]
1294 
1295  \f[
1296  z = range \times sin(\phi) = range * \frac{\omega_z}{2 \pi d_z}
1297  \f]
1298 
1299  */
1300  elevSinPhase = wz * (1.0f / (2.0f * PI_ * objDetObj->commonCfg.antennaSpacing.zSpacingByLambda));
1301  if ((elevSinPhase > subFrmObj->aoaFovSinVal.minElevationSinVal) && (elevSinPhase < subFrmObj->aoaFovSinVal.maxElevationSinVal))
1302  {
1303  z = range * elevSinPhase;
1304 
1305  /*
1306  \f[
1307  x = range cos(\phi) sin(\theta) = range /frac{\omega_x}{2 \pi d_x}
1308  \f]
1309 
1310  */
1311  peakLocFlt = peakLoc * (1.0f/ AOA_DFT_LEN);
1312  if (peakLocFlt > 0.5f)
1313  {
1314  peakLocFlt -= 1.0f;
1315  }
1316 
1317  x = range * peakLocFlt * (1.0f / objDetObj->commonCfg.antennaSpacing.xSpacingByLambda);
1318 
1319  /* Obtain 'square of y' coordinate
1320  \f[
1321  y^2 = range^2 -x^2 - z^2
1322  \f]
1323  */
1324  ySquared = (range * range) - (z * z) - (x * x);
1325 
1326  /* It is possible that ySquared is less than zero (i.e. a degenerate case). In such a case ignore the object.
1327  * If the case is not degenerate, proceed to check if the object is in the field of view (FoV).
1328  * If so , store the newly validated object in the final object list.*/
1329  if (ySquared > 0)
1330  {
1331  /* Estimate azimuth phase.
1332  \f[
1333  sin(\Theta) = \frac{x}{range \times cos(\Phi)}
1334  \f]
1335  */
1336  elevCosPhase = sqrtsp(1 - (elevSinPhase * elevSinPhase));
1337  azimSinPhase = divsp(x, (range * elevCosPhase));
1338 
1339  /* Check if object is in azimuth FoV, If object is in FoV, proceed to store the coordinates in the final object list */
1340  if ((azimSinPhase > subFrmObj->aoaFovSinVal.minAzimuthSinVal) && (azimSinPhase < subFrmObj->aoaFovSinVal.maxAzimuthSinVal))
1341  {
1342 
1343  /* Store x, y, z values */
1344  objOut[ValidObjIdx].z = z;
1345  objOut[ValidObjIdx].x = x;
1346  objOut[ValidObjIdx].y = sqrtsp(ySquared);
1347 
1348  /* Obtain and store Velocity */
1349  if (detObjList[objIdx].dopIdxActual > numDopplerBins / 2)
1350  {
1351  dopIdx = detObjList[objIdx].dopIdxActual - numDopplerBins;
1352  }
1353  else
1354  {
1355  dopIdx = detObjList[objIdx].dopIdxActual;
1356  }
1357  objOut[ValidObjIdx].velocity = dopIdx * dopplerStep;
1358 
1359  /* Calcute the side info of final detected object */
1360  /* output is 20*log10(2)*value/2^(QVALUE) */
1361  noisedB = 6.0 * ((float)detObjList[objIdx].dopCfarNoise) * (1.0f/(1 << QVALUE_NOISE));
1362  signaldB = 6.0 * ((float)detObjList[objIdx].azimPeakSamples[1]) * (1.0f/(1<<QVALUE_SIGNAL));
1363  snrdB = signaldB - noisedB;
1364 
1365  subFrmObj->detObjOutSideInfo[ValidObjIdx].snr = (int)(10*snrdB);
1366  subFrmObj->detObjOutSideInfo[ValidObjIdx].noise = (int)(10*noisedB);
1367 
1368  /* Increment output list index */
1369  ValidObjIdx++;
1370  }
1371  }
1372  } /* End of elevation FoV check cond */
1373  }
1374  *finalNumObjOut = ValidObjIdx;
1375 
1376  goto exit;
1377 exit:
1378  return retVal;
1379 }
1380 #endif

1392 static void channelOffsetConfig(uint8_t channel, uint16_t offset)
1393 {
1394 #if defined(SOC_AWR2X44P)
1395  CSL_rss_ctrlRegs *ptrrssCtrlRegs = (CSL_rss_ctrlRegs *)CSL_CM4_RSS_CTRL_U_BASE;
1396 #else
1397  CSL_rss_ctrlRegs *ptrrssCtrlRegs = (CSL_rss_ctrlRegs *)CSL_RSS_CTRL_U_BASE;
1398 #endif
1399 
1400  switch (channel)
1401  {
1402  case 0U:
1403 
1404  /* Setup the offset */
1405  CSL_REG32_FINS_RAW(&ptrrssCtrlRegs->ADCBUFCFG2,
1406  CSL_RSS_CTRL_ADCBUFCFG2_ADCBUFCFG2_ADCBUFADDRX0_MASK,
1407  CSL_RSS_CTRL_ADCBUFCFG2_ADCBUFCFG2_ADCBUFADDRX0_SHIFT,
1408  ((uint32_t)offset >> 4U));
1409  break;
1410  case 1U:
1411 
1412  /* Setup the offset */
1413  CSL_REG32_FINS_RAW(&ptrrssCtrlRegs->ADCBUFCFG2,
1414  CSL_RSS_CTRL_ADCBUFCFG2_ADCBUFCFG2_ADCBUFADDRX1_MASK,
1415  CSL_RSS_CTRL_ADCBUFCFG2_ADCBUFCFG2_ADCBUFADDRX1_SHIFT,
1416  ((uint32_t)offset >> 4U));
1417  break;
1418  case 2U:
1419 
1420  /* Setup the offset */
1421  CSL_REG32_FINS_RAW(&ptrrssCtrlRegs->ADCBUFCFG3,
1422  CSL_RSS_CTRL_ADCBUFCFG3_ADCBUFCFG3_ADCBUFADDRX2_MASK,
1423  CSL_RSS_CTRL_ADCBUFCFG3_ADCBUFCFG3_ADCBUFADDRX2_SHIFT,
1424  ((uint32_t)offset >> 4U));
1425  break;
1426  case 3U:
1427 
1428  /* Setup the offset */
1429  CSL_REG32_FINS_RAW(&ptrrssCtrlRegs->ADCBUFCFG3,
1430  CSL_RSS_CTRL_ADCBUFCFG3_ADCBUFCFG3_ADCBUFADDRX3_MASK,
1431  CSL_RSS_CTRL_ADCBUFCFG3_ADCBUFCFG3_ADCBUFADDRX3_SHIFT,
1432  ((uint32_t)offset >> 4U));
1433  break;
1434 
1435  default:
1436  /* Not supported channels, code should not end up here */
1437  DebugP_assert(false);
1438  break;
1439  }

1452 static void DPC_ObjectDetection_ConfigureADCBuf(
1453  uint16_t rxChannelEn,
1454  uint32_t chanDataSize)
1455 {
1456  uint8_t channel;
1457  uint16_t offset = 0;
1458 
1459  /* channel offset reconfigure */
1460 
1461  for (channel = 0; channel < SYS_COMMON_NUM_RX_CHANNEL; channel++)
1462  {
1463  if ((rxChannelEn & ((uint16_t)0x1U << channel)) != 0U)
1464  {
1465  channelOffsetConfig(channel, offset);
1466  /* Calculate offset for the next channel */
1467  offset += (uint16_t)chanDataSize;
1468  }
1469  }
1470 }

1493 static void DPC_ObjDet_RxChPhaseMeasure
1494 (
1495  DPC_ObjectDetection_StaticCfg *staticCfg,
1496  float targetDistance,
1497  float searchWinSize,
1498  uint16_t *detMatrix,
1499  DetObjParams *detObjList,
1500  uint32_t numObjOut,
1501  Measure_compRxChannelBiasCfg *compRxChanCfg
1502 )
1503 {
1504  float antMagSq[SYS_COMMON_NUM_RX_CHANNEL * SYS_COMMON_NUM_TX_ANTENNAS];
1505  float antMagSqMin;
1506  float scal;
1507  float truePosition;
1508  int32_t truePositionIndex;
1509  int32_t halfWinSize;
1510  uint8_t antennaIdx, elevIdx;
1511  uint32_t objIdx, rangeidx;
1512  int32_t iMaxPos =-1, objIdxMax =-1;
1513  int32_t temp;
1514  float temp_f;
1515 
1516  uint16_t numDopFFTSubBins = staticCfg->numDopplerBins / staticCfg->numBandsTotal;
1517  uint16_t maxVal = 0;
1518 
1519  truePosition = targetDistance / staticCfg->rangeStep;
1520  temp_f = truePosition + 0.5F;
1521  truePositionIndex = (int32_t) (temp_f);
1522 
1523  temp_f = 0.5F * searchWinSize / staticCfg->rangeStep + 0.5F;
1524  halfWinSize = (int32_t) (temp_f);
1525 
1526  /**** Strongest target position index ****/
1527  for(objIdx=0; objIdx< numObjOut; objIdx++){
1530  rangeidx = detObjList[objIdx].rangeIdx;
1531 
1532  if(( (int32_t)rangeidx >= (truePositionIndex - halfWinSize)) && ((int32_t)rangeidx <= (truePositionIndex + halfWinSize))){
1533  /* doppler bin =0 ; considering target at zero velocity*/
1534  if (detMatrix[rangeidx*numDopFFTSubBins] > maxVal)
1535  {
1536  maxVal = detMatrix[rangeidx * numDopFFTSubBins];
1537  iMaxPos = (int32_t)rangeidx;
1538  objIdxMax = (int32_t)objIdx;
1539  }
1540  }
1541  }
1542 
1543  /*should not be first range bin (0) or -1 (error) */
1544  if(iMaxPos>0){
1545  /*** Calculate antenna normalization coefficients ***/
1546  for (antennaIdx = 0; antennaIdx < staticCfg->numVirtualAntennas; antennaIdx++)
1547  {
1548  if(antennaIdx < staticCfg->numVirtualAntAzim){
1549  antMagSq[antennaIdx] = (float) detObjList[objIdxMax].azimSamples[antennaIdx].real * (float) detObjList[objIdxMax].azimSamples[antennaIdx].real +
1550  (float) detObjList[objIdxMax].azimSamples[antennaIdx].imag * (float) detObjList[objIdxMax].azimSamples[antennaIdx].imag;
1551  }
1552  else{
1553  elevIdx = antennaIdx - staticCfg->numVirtualAntAzim;
1554  antMagSq[antennaIdx] = (float) detObjList[objIdxMax].elevSamples[elevIdx].real * (float) detObjList[objIdxMax].elevSamples[elevIdx].real +
1555  (float) detObjList[objIdxMax].elevSamples[elevIdx].imag * (float) detObjList[objIdxMax].elevSamples[elevIdx].imag;
1556  }
1557  }
1558 
1559  if(staticCfg->numVirtualAntennas > 0U)
1560  {
1561  antMagSqMin = antMagSq[0];
1562  for (antennaIdx = 1; antennaIdx < staticCfg->numVirtualAntennas; antennaIdx++)
1563  {
1564  if (antMagSq[antennaIdx] < antMagSqMin)
1565  {
1566  antMagSqMin = antMagSq[antennaIdx];
1567  }
1568  }
1569 
1570  for (antennaIdx = 0; antennaIdx < staticCfg->numVirtualAntennas; antennaIdx++)
1571  {
1572  scal = 16384.0F/ antMagSq[antennaIdx] * (float)sqrt((float)antMagSqMin);
1573 
1574  if(antennaIdx < staticCfg->numVirtualAntAzim){
1575  temp_f = MATHUTILS_ROUND_FLOAT(scal * (float)detObjList[objIdxMax].azimSamples[antennaIdx].real);
1576  temp = (int32_t) (temp_f);
1577  MATHUTILS_SATURATE16(temp);
1578  compRxChanCfg->rxChPhaseComp[antennaIdx].real = (int16_t) (temp);
1579 
1580  temp_f = MATHUTILS_ROUND_FLOAT(-scal * (float)detObjList[objIdxMax].azimSamples[antennaIdx].imag);
1581  temp = (int32_t) (temp_f);
1582  MATHUTILS_SATURATE16(temp);
1583  compRxChanCfg->rxChPhaseComp[antennaIdx].imag = (int16_t) (temp);
1584  }
1585 
1586  else{
1587  elevIdx = antennaIdx - staticCfg->numVirtualAntAzim;
1588  temp_f = MATHUTILS_ROUND_FLOAT(scal * (float)detObjList[objIdxMax].elevSamples[elevIdx].real);
1589  temp = (int32_t) (temp_f);
1590  MATHUTILS_SATURATE16(temp);
1591  compRxChanCfg->rxChPhaseComp[antennaIdx].real = (int16_t) (temp);
1592 
1593  temp_f = MATHUTILS_ROUND_FLOAT(-scal * (float)detObjList[objIdxMax].elevSamples[elevIdx].imag);
1594  temp = (int32_t) (temp_f);
1595  MATHUTILS_SATURATE16(temp);
1596  compRxChanCfg->rxChPhaseComp[antennaIdx].imag = (int16_t) (temp);
1597  }
1598  }
1599  compRxChanCfg->targetRange = (float)detObjList[objIdxMax].rangeIdx * staticCfg->rangeStep;
1600  compRxChanCfg->peakVal = maxVal;
1601  }
1602  }
1603  else{
1604  /* target object not found */
1605  for (antennaIdx = 0; antennaIdx < staticCfg->numVirtualAntennas; antennaIdx++)
1606  {
1607  compRxChanCfg->rxChPhaseComp[antennaIdx].real = 16384;
1608  compRxChanCfg->rxChPhaseComp[antennaIdx].imag = 0;
1609  }
1610  compRxChanCfg->targetRange = -1.0F;
1611  compRxChanCfg->peakVal = 0;
1612  }
1613 }

1628 static void checkFFTClipStatus(ObjDetObj *objDetObj, uint32_t* clipCount)
1629 {
1630  uint16_t clipStatusResult = 0U;
1631 
1632  /* Check the FFT clip Register after range fft */
1633  (void)HWA_readClipStatus(objDetObj->hwaHandle, &clipStatusResult, HWA_CLIPREG_TYPE_FFT);
1634  /* Is FFT clipped? Yes: increment the clip count */
1635  if(clipStatusResult!=0U)
1636  {
1637  (*clipCount)++;
1638  }
1639  /* Clear the FFT clip register */
1640  (void)HWA_clearClipStatus(objDetObj->hwaHandle, HWA_CLIPREG_TYPE_FFT);
1641 }

1662 static int32_t DPC_ObjDet_intersectDopAndRangeCFAR(
1663  ObjDetObj *objDetObj,
1664  SubFrameObj *subFrmObj,
1665  uint32_t dopNumObjOut,
1666  DetObjParams *detObjList,
1667  uint32_t *finalNumDetObjs
1668 )
1669 {
1670  int32_t retVal=0;
1671  uint16_t valSubBinObj, cfarListStartIdx;
1672  uint32_t isValidObj, objIdx, dopIdx, finalNumObjs = 0;
1673  uint16_t * rangeCfarObjPerDopList;
1674  uint32_t baseAddr = EDMA_getBaseAddr(objDetObj->edmaHandle[0]);
1675  uint32_t edmaSrcAddr, edmaDstAddr, edmaTrigReg, edmaIntrStatusReg, edmaClrIntrStatusReg, channelMask;
1676  edmaSrcAddr = baseAddr + EDMA_TPCC_OPT(objDetObj->edmaDetObjs.channel) + 0x4U;
1677  edmaDstAddr = edmaSrcAddr + 0x8U;
1678  edmaTrigReg = baseAddr + EDMA_TPCC_ESR_RN(0U);
1679  edmaIntrStatusReg = baseAddr + EDMA_TPCC_IPR_RN(0U);
1680  edmaClrIntrStatusReg = baseAddr + EDMA_TPCC_ICR_RN(0U);
1681  channelMask = (uint32_t)1U << objDetObj->edmaDetObjs.channel;
1682 
1683  /* As the detected object list is written on radar cube, find the intersection of range-cfar
1684  and doppler proc stage here, and copy the result to Local Scratch Buf before triggering range proc.
1685  As range processing will result in overwritten of detObjList by the radar cube.
1686  This step is required as Elev Estimation has to happen in parallel with Range Proc. */
1687  if(subFrmObj->staticCfg.rangeCfarCfg.cfg.isEnabled)
1688  {
1689  rangeCfarObjPerDopList = (uint16_t *)subFrmObj->dpuCfg.rangeCfarCfg.res.rangeCfarNumObjPerDopplerBinBuf;
1690  for (objIdx = 0; objIdx < dopNumObjOut; objIdx++)
1691  {
1692  dopIdx = detObjList[objIdx].dopIdx;
1693 
1694  if (dopIdx > 0U)
1695  {
1696  /* Obtain the number of objects for a sub bin in the Range CFAR list by
1697  * subtracting two consecutive elements from the cummulative distribution */
1698  valSubBinObj = rangeCfarObjPerDopList[dopIdx] - rangeCfarObjPerDopList[dopIdx - 1U];
1699  cfarListStartIdx = rangeCfarObjPerDopList[dopIdx - 1U];
1700  }
1701  else
1702  {
1703  /* For the 0th sub bin, do not perform a subtraction */
1704  valSubBinObj = rangeCfarObjPerDopList[dopIdx];
1705  cfarListStartIdx = 0;
1706  }
1707 
1708  /* If the sub bin has valid objects in the range CFAR list, check whether the
1709  * object currently being looked at (from the Doppler CFAR list), is also available
1710  * in the range CFAR list. cfarListStartIdx tells us where to start searching for in
1711  * the range CFAR list, and valSubBinObj tells us how many elements to search in.
1712  * This saves computation time. */
1713  if (valSubBinObj)
1714  {
1715  isValidObj = isObjInRangeAndDopplerList((uint32_t)detObjList[objIdx].rangeIdx,
1716  detObjList[objIdx].dopIdx,
1717  (RangeCfarListObj *)&subFrmObj->dpuCfg.rangeCfarCfg.res.rangeCfarList[cfarListStartIdx],
1718  valSubBinObj);
1719 
1720  if(isValidObj)
1721  {
1722  /* Check the completion of previous transfer before triggering the next. */
1723  if(finalNumObjs > 0U)
1724  {
1725  while(((*(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaIntrStatusReg)) & (channelMask)) != (channelMask))
1726  {
1727  /* wait */
1728  }
1729  *(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaClrIntrStatusReg) = channelMask;
1730  }
1731 
1732 
1733  /* EDMA this obj to L2 for further processing */
1734 
1735  /* update src address */
1736  *(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaSrcAddr) = (uint32_t)SOC_virtToPhy((void*)&subFrmObj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.hwRes.detObjList[objIdx]);
1737 
1738  /* update dst address */
1739  *(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaDstAddr) = (uint32_t)SOC_virtToPhy((void*)&subFrmObj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.hwRes.finalDetObjList[finalNumObjs]);
1740 
1741  /* trigger */
1742  *(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaTrigReg) = channelMask;
1743 
1744  finalNumObjs++;
1745  if(finalNumObjs >= subFrmObj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.hwRes.finalMaxNumDetObjs)
1746  {
1747  break;
1748  }
1749  }
1750  }
1751  }
1752 
1753  /* Monitor the completion of last transfer here. */
1754  if(finalNumObjs > 0U)
1755  {
1756  while(((*(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaIntrStatusReg)) & (channelMask)) != (channelMask))
1757  {
1758  /* wait */
1759  }
1760  *(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaClrIntrStatusReg) = channelMask;
1761  }
1762  }
1763  else
1764  {
1765  /* Copy the entire detected object list to L2.
1766  We can copy only a limited number of objects (set to finalMaxNumDetObjs).
1767  This constraint is due to limited available L2 buffer memory. */
1768  finalNumObjs = (dopNumObjOut > subFrmObj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.hwRes.finalMaxNumDetObjs)? subFrmObj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.hwRes.finalMaxNumDetObjs : dopNumObjOut;
1769 
1770  /* Check if only A-dim transfer is sufficient to do this. If not, increase the number of B-dim transfers. */
1771  uint32_t acnt = finalNumObjs * sizeof(DetObjParams);
1772  uint32_t bcnt = 1;
1773  while( acnt > 65535U )
1774  {
1775  acnt /= 2U;
1776  bcnt *= 2U;
1777  }
1778 
1779  uint32_t bcnt_acnt = ((uint32_t)bcnt << 16U) | (uint32_t)acnt;
1780  EDMA_dmaSetPaRAMEntry(baseAddr, objDetObj->edmaDetObjs.channel, EDMACC_PARAM_ENTRY_ACNT_BCNT, bcnt_acnt);
1781  uint32_t dstBidx_srcBidx = ((uint32_t)acnt << 16U) | (uint32_t)acnt;
1782  EDMA_dmaSetPaRAMEntry(baseAddr, objDetObj->edmaDetObjs.channel, EDMACC_PARAM_ENTRY_SRC_DST_BIDX, dstBidx_srcBidx);
1783 
1784  *(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaTrigReg) = channelMask;
1785  while(((*(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaIntrStatusReg)) & (channelMask)) != (channelMask))
1786  {
1787  /* wait */
1788  }
1789  *(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaClrIntrStatusReg) = channelMask;
1790  }
1791 
1792  *finalNumDetObjs = finalNumObjs;
1793 
1794  return retVal;
1795 }
1796 
1816 int32_t DPC_ObjectDetection_execute(
1817  DPM_DPCHandle handle,
1818  DPM_Buffer *ptrResult)
1819 {
1820  ObjDetObj *objDetObj;
1821  SubFrameObj *subFrmObj;
1822  DPU_RangeProcHWA_OutParams outRangeProc;
1823  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_OutParams outDopplerProc;
1824  DPU_RangeCFARProcHWA_OutParams outRangeCfarProc;
1825  DetObjParams * detObjList;
1826  DPIF_PointCloudCartesian * objOut;
1827  uint32_t saveRestoreDataSize;
1828  int32_t retVal;
1829  DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResult *result;
1830  DPC_ObjectDetection_ProcessCallBackCfg *processCallBack;
1831  int32_t i;
1832 
1833  objDetObj = (ObjDetObj *) handle;
1834  DebugP_assert (objDetObj != NULL);
1835  DebugP_assert (ptrResult != NULL);
1836 
1837 #ifndef INCLUDE_DPM
1838  (void)SemaphoreP_pend(&objDetObj->dpcExecSemHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
1839 #endif
1840 
1841  processCallBack = &objDetObj->processCallBackCfg;
1842 
1843  if (processCallBack->processFrameBeginCallBackFxn != NULL)
1844  {
1845  (*processCallBack->processFrameBeginCallBackFxn)(objDetObj->subFrameIndx);
1846  }
1847 
1848  result = &objDetObj->executeResult;
1849 
1850  subFrmObj = &objDetObj->subFrameObj[objDetObj->subFrameIndx];
1851 
1852  /* Cache invalidation is required to mitigate incoherency
1853  * issues associated with EDMA transfer from/to L3. */
1854  CacheP_wbInvAll(CacheP_TYPE_ALL);
1855 
1856  retVal = DPU_RangeProcHWA_process(subFrmObj->dpuRangeObj, &subFrmObj->dpuCfg.rangeCfg, &outRangeProc);
1857  if (retVal != 0)
1858  {
1859  goto exit;
1860  }
1861  DebugP_assert(outRangeProc.endOfChirp == true);
1862 
1863  checkFFTClipStatus(objDetObj, &result->FFTClipCount[0]);
1864 
1865  if (processCallBack->processInterFrameBeginCallBackFxn != NULL)
1866  {
1867  (*processCallBack->processInterFrameBeginCallBackFxn)(objDetObj->subFrameIndx);
1868  }
1869 
1870  objDetObj->stats.interFrameStartTimeStamp = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
1871 
1872 #ifdef INCLUDE_DPM
1873  DPC_Objdet_Assert(objDetObj->dpmHandle, (objDetObj->interSubFrameProcToken == 0));
1874 #else
1875  DebugP_assert(objDetObj->interSubFrameProcToken == 0);
1876 #endif
1877  objDetObj->interSubFrameProcToken++;
1878 
1879 #ifdef OBJECTDETHWA_PRINT_DPC_TIMING_INFO
1880  gTimingInfo.rangeEndTimes[gTimingInfo.rangeEndCnt % OBJECTDETHWA_NUM_FRAME_TIMING_TO_STORE] = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
1881  gTimingInfo.rangeEndCnt++;
1882 #endif
1883 
1884 #ifdef SOC_AWR2X44P
1885  CSL_dss_rcmRegs *ptrDssRcmRegs = (CSL_dss_rcmRegs *)CSL_CM4_DSS_RCM_U_BASE;
1886 
1887  if (subFrmObj->staticCfg.powerOptCfg.dspStateAfterFrameProc == DPC_OBJDET_DSP_PG_ENABLE)
1888  {
1889  if ((ptrDssRcmRegs->DSP_PD_STATUS & DPC_OBJDET_DSP_PD_STATUS_MASK) == DPC_OBJDET_DSP_POWERED_DOWN)
1890  {
1891  /* Trigger Wakeup */
1892  ptrDssRcmRegs->DSP_PD_TRIGGER_WAKUP |= 0x1U;
1893  while((ptrDssRcmRegs->DSP_PD_STATUS & DPC_OBJDET_DSP_PD_STATUS_MASK) != DPC_OBJDET_DSP_POWERED_UP)
1894  {
1895  /* Wait for DSP power up */
1896  }
1897  }
1898  }
1899  else if (subFrmObj->staticCfg.powerOptCfg.dspStateAfterFrameProc == DPC_OBJDET_DSP_UC_ENABLE)
1900  {
1901  /* Switch DSP core clock back to normal rate */
1902  ptrDssRcmRegs->DSS_DSP_CLK_SRC_SEL = DPC_OBJDET_DSP_CLK_SRC_DSP_PLL_MUX;
1903  }
1904 #endif
1905  retVal = DPU_DopplerProcHWA_process(subFrmObj->dpuDopplerObj, &subFrmObj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg, &outDopplerProc);
1906  if (retVal != 0)
1907  {
1908  goto exit;
1909  }
1910 #ifdef OBJECTDETHWA_PRINT_DPC_TIMING_INFO
1911  gTimingInfo.dopEndTimes[gTimingInfo.dopEndCnt % OBJECTDETHWA_NUM_FRAME_TIMING_TO_STORE] = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
1912  gTimingInfo.dopEndCnt++;
1913 #endif
1914 
1915  checkFFTClipStatus(objDetObj, &result->FFTClipCount[1]);
1916 
1917  if (subFrmObj->staticCfg.rangeCfarCfg.cfg.isEnabled)
1918  {
1919  retVal = DPU_RangeCFARProcHWA_process(subFrmObj->dpuRangeCfarObj, &subFrmObj->dpuCfg.rangeCfarCfg, &outRangeCfarProc);
1920  if (retVal != 0)
1921  {
1922  goto exit;
1923  }
1924  }
1925 
1926  detObjList = subFrmObj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.hwRes.detObjList;
1927  objOut = subFrmObj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.hwRes.objOut;
1928 
1929  /* Procedure for Rx channels gain/phase offset measurement */
1930  if(objDetObj->commonCfg.measureRxChannelBiasCfg.enabled)
1931  {
1932  DPC_ObjDet_RxChPhaseMeasure(&subFrmObj->staticCfg,
1933  objDetObj->commonCfg.measureRxChannelBiasCfg.targetDistance,
1934  objDetObj->commonCfg.measureRxChannelBiasCfg.searchWinSize,
1935  subFrmObj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.hwRes.detMatrix.data,
1936  detObjList,
1937  outDopplerProc.numObjOut,
1938  &objDetObj->compRxChanCfgMeasureOut);
1939  }
1940 
1941 #if !defined(OBJ_DETECTION_DDMA_TEST) && defined(SOC_AWR2X44P)
1942  SemaphoreP_pend(&gDPCStateSemHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
1943 #endif
1944 
1945  retVal = DPC_ObjDet_intersectDopAndRangeCFAR(objDetObj, subFrmObj, outDopplerProc.numObjOut, detObjList, &result->dopNumObjOut) ;
1946  if (retVal < 0)
1947  {
1948  goto exit;
1949  }
1950 
1951  /********************************
1952  * Prepare for subFrame switch
1953  *******************************/
1954  if (objDetObj->commonCfg.numSubFrames > 1U)
1955  {
1956  uint8_t nextSubFrameIdx;
1957  SubFrameObj *nextSubFrmObj;
1958 
1959  DPC_ObjectDetection_ADCBufConfig nextSubFrameADCBufConfig;
1960 
1961  if (objDetObj->subFrameIndx == (objDetObj->commonCfg.numSubFrames - 1U))
1962  {
1963  nextSubFrameIdx = 0;
1964  }
1965  else
1966  {
1967  nextSubFrameIdx = objDetObj->subFrameIndx + 1U;
1968  }
1969  /* get next subframe objDetObj */
1970  nextSubFrmObj = &objDetObj->subFrameObj[nextSubFrameIdx];
1971 
1972  if(objDetObj->commonCfg.rangeProcCfg.rangeProcChain == DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_PREVIOUS_FRAME_DC_MODE)
1973  {
1974  /* In this rangeProcChain, if subframe switching is happening,
1975  * corresponding subframe indices' DC Estimation statistics need to be loaded and stored. */
1976  saveRestoreDataSize = (uint32_t)subFrmObj->staticCfg.ADCBufData.dataProperty.numRxAntennas * 4U;
1977  if(objDetObj->commonCfg.rangeProcCfg.isReal2XEnabled)
1978  {
1979  /* In Real2X mode, number of elements is halved */
1980  saveRestoreDataSize >>= 1;
1981  }
1982  rangeProcHWA_storePreProcStats(&subFrmObj->dpuCfg.rangeCfg, saveRestoreDataSize, 0, 0);
1983  rangeProcHWA_loadPreProcStats(&nextSubFrmObj->dpuCfg.rangeCfg, saveRestoreDataSize, 0, 0);
1984  }
1985 
1986  nextSubFrameADCBufConfig = nextSubFrmObj->staticCfg.ADCBufConfig;
1987  /* Configure ADC for next sub-frame */
1988  DPC_ObjectDetection_ConfigureADCBuf(
1989  nextSubFrameADCBufConfig.rxChannelEn,
1990  nextSubFrameADCBufConfig.adcBufChanDataSize);
1991  (void)DPC_ObjDet_reconfigSubFrame(objDetObj, nextSubFrameIdx);
1992 
1993  /* Trigger Range DPU for the next sub frame */
1994  retVal = DPU_RangeProcHWA_control(nextSubFrmObj->dpuRangeObj, &nextSubFrmObj->dpuCfg.rangeCfg,
1995  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Cmd_triggerProc, NULL, 0);
1996  if (retVal < 0)
1997  {
1998  goto exit;
1999  }
2000  }
2001  else
2002  {
2003  /* Trigger Range DPU for the next frame */
2004  retVal = DPU_RangeProcHWA_control(subFrmObj->dpuRangeObj, &subFrmObj->dpuCfg.rangeCfg,
2005  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Cmd_triggerProc, NULL, 0);
2006  if (retVal < 0)
2007  {
2008  goto exit;
2009  }
2010  }
2011 
2012 #ifdef SUBSYS_DSS
2013 #ifdef OBJECTDETHWA_PRINT_DPC_TIMING_INFO
2014  gTimingInfo.aoaStartTimes[gTimingInfo.aoaStartCnt % OBJECTDETHWA_NUM_FRAME_TIMING_TO_STORE] = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
2015  gTimingInfo.aoaStartCnt++;
2016 #endif
2017 
2018  retVal = DPC_ObjDet_estimateXYZ(subFrmObj, objDetObj, subFrmObj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.hwRes.finalDetObjList, objOut, result->dopNumObjOut, &result->numObjOut);
2019  if (retVal != 0)
2020  {
2021  goto exit;
2022  }
2023 #endif
2024 #ifdef OBJECTDETHWA_PRINT_DPC_TIMING_INFO
2025  gTimingInfo.aoaEndTimes[gTimingInfo.aoaEndCnt % OBJECTDETHWA_NUM_FRAME_TIMING_TO_STORE] = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
2026  gTimingInfo.aoaEndCnt++;
2027 #endif
2028 
2029  /* Set DPM result */
2030  result->subFrameIdx = objDetObj->subFrameIndx;
2031  result->objOut = objOut;
2032  result->objOutSideInfo = subFrmObj->detObjOutSideInfo;
2033  result->detMatrix = subFrmObj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.hwRes.detMatrix;
2034  result->detObjList = subFrmObj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.hwRes.finalDetObjList;
2035 
2036  if (objDetObj->commonCfg.measureRxChannelBiasCfg.enabled == 1U)
2037  {
2038  result->compRxChanBiasMeasurement = &objDetObj->compRxChanCfgMeasureOut;
2039  }
2040  else
2041  {
2042  result->compRxChanBiasMeasurement = NULL;
2043  }
2044 
2045  /* For rangeProcHwa, interChirpProcessingMargin is not available */
2046  objDetObj->stats.interChirpProcessingMargin = 0;
2047 
2048  objDetObj->stats.interFrameEndTimeStamp = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
2049  result->stats = (DPC_ObjectDetection_Stats *)((uint32_t)SOC_virtToPhy((void*)&objDetObj->stats));
2050 
2051  /* populate DPM_resultBuf - first pointer and size are for results of the
2052  * processing */
2053  ptrResult->ptrBuffer[0] = (uint8_t *)result;
2054  ptrResult->size[0] = sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResult);
2055 
2056  /* clear rest of the result */
2057  for (i = 1; i < DPM_MAX_BUFFER; i++)
2058  {
2059  ptrResult->ptrBuffer[i] = NULL;
2060  ptrResult->size[i] = 0;
2061  }
2062 
2063 #ifndef INCLUDE_DPM
2064 #ifdef SOC_AWR2X44P
2065  /* HWA Clk Gate */
2066  subFrmObj = &objDetObj->subFrameObj[objDetObj->subFrameIndx];
2067  if (subFrmObj->staticCfg.powerOptCfg.hwaStateAfterFrameProc == DPC_OBJDET_HWA_CG_ENABLE)
2068  {
2069  /* Gate HWA Peripheral Clock */
2070  ptrDssRcmRegs->DSS_HWA_CLK_GATE = DPC_OBJDET_HWA_CLOCK_GATE;
2071  }
2072 #endif
2073  /* Increment the subframe index to get the next subrame object */
2074  if (objDetObj->commonCfg.numSubFrames > 1U)
2075  {
2076  /* Next sub-frame */
2077  objDetObj->subFrameIndx++;
2078  if (objDetObj->subFrameIndx == objDetObj->commonCfg.numSubFrames)
2079  {
2080  objDetObj->subFrameIndx = 0;
2081  }
2082  }
2083  /* Mark the end of DPC Processing for the current frame/ subframe. */
2084  objDetObj->interSubFrameProcToken--;
2085 #endif
2086 
2087 exit:
2088  return retVal;
2089 }

2163 int32_t DPC_ObjectDetection_start (DPM_DPCHandle handle)
2164 {
2165  ObjDetObj *objDetObj;
2166  SubFrameObj *subFrmObj;
2167  uint32_t dcEstBufSize = 0;
2168  int32_t retVal = 0;
2169 
2170  objDetObj = (ObjDetObj *) handle;
2171  DebugP_assert (objDetObj != NULL);
2172 
2173  objDetObj->stats.frameStartIntCounter = 0;
2174  objDetObj->stats.subframeStartIntCounter = 0;
2175  objDetObj->numTimesResultExported = 0;
2176  (void)memset((void*)&objDetObj->executeResult.FFTClipCount[0], 0, sizeof(objDetObj->executeResult.FFTClipCount));
2177 
2178 #ifdef OBJECTDETHWA_PRINT_DPC_TIMING_INFO
2179  (void)memset((void*)&gTimingInfo, 0, sizeof(timingInfo));
2180 #endif
2181 
2182  /* Start marks consumption of all pre-start configs, reset the flag to check
2183  * if pre-starts were issued only after common config was issued for the next
2184  * time full configuration happens between stop and start */
2185  objDetObj->isCommonCfgReceived = false;
2186 
2187  /* App must issue export of last frame after stop which will switch to sub-frame 0,
2188  * so start should always see sub-frame indx of 0, check */
2189  DebugP_assert(objDetObj->subFrameIndx == 0U);
2190 
2191  /* Pre-start cfgs for sub-frames may have come in any order, so need
2192  * to ensure we reconfig for the current (0) sub-frame before starting */
2193  (void)DPC_ObjDet_reconfigSubFrame(objDetObj, objDetObj->subFrameIndx);
2194 
2195  /* Initialize HWA DC estimate register for the first subframe
2196  * For subsequent subframes, this is done in the DPU.
2197  */
2198  if((objDetObj->commonCfg.rangeProcCfg.rangeProcChain == DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_PREVIOUS_FRAME_DC_MODE)
2199  && (objDetObj->commonCfg.numSubFrames > 1U))
2200  {
2201  dcEstBufSize = objDetObj->subFrameObj[0].staticCfg.ADCBufData.dataProperty.numRxAntennas * sizeof(uint32_t);
2202  if(objDetObj->commonCfg.rangeProcCfg.isReal2XEnabled)
2203  {
2204  dcEstBufSize >>= 1;
2205  }
2206  rangeProcHWA_loadPreProcStats(&objDetObj->subFrameObj[0].dpuCfg.rangeCfg, dcEstBufSize, 0, 0);
2207  }
2208 
2209  /* Trigger Range DPU, related to reconfig above */
2210  subFrmObj = &objDetObj->subFrameObj[objDetObj->subFrameIndx];
2211 
2212  retVal = DPU_RangeProcHWA_control(subFrmObj->dpuRangeObj, &subFrmObj->dpuCfg.rangeCfg,
2213  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Cmd_triggerProc, NULL, 0);
2214  if(retVal < 0)
2215  {
2216  goto exit;
2217  }
2218 
2219 #if !defined(OBJ_DETECTION_DDMA_TEST) && defined(SOC_AWR2X44P)
2220  SemaphoreP_post(&gDPCStateSemHandle);
2221 #endif
2222 
2223  DebugP_logInfo("ObjDet DPC: Start done\n");
2224 exit:
2225  return(retVal);
2226 }

2268 int32_t DPC_ObjectDetection_stop (DPM_DPCHandle handle)
2269 {
2270  ObjDetObj *objDetObj;
2271 
2272  objDetObj = (ObjDetObj *) handle;
2273  DebugP_assert (objDetObj != NULL);
2274 
2275  /* print the FFT clip status */
2276  if(objDetObj->executeResult.FFTClipCount[0]>0U)
2277  {
2278  DebugP_log("Warning! FFT clipping happened for %d times in Range FFT Stage. \n", objDetObj->executeResult.FFTClipCount[0]);
2279  }
2280  if(objDetObj->executeResult.FFTClipCount[1]>0U)
2281  {
2282  DebugP_log("Warning! FFT clipping happened for %d times in Doppler or Azimuth FFT Stage. \n", objDetObj->executeResult.FFTClipCount[1]);
2283  }
2284 
2285 #ifdef OBJECTDETHWA_PRINT_DPC_TIMING_INFO
2286  uint32_t i, frame0StartTime;
2287  frame0StartTime = gTimingInfo.frameStartTimes[(gTimingInfo.frameCnt) % OBJECTDETHWA_NUM_FRAME_TIMING_TO_STORE];
2288  for (i = 0; i < OBJECTDETHWA_NUM_FRAME_TIMING_TO_STORE; i++)
2289  {
2290  gTimingInfo.frameStartTimes[i] -= frame0StartTime;
2291  gTimingInfo.frameStartTimes[i] /= OBJECTDETHWA_TIMING_CPU_CLK_FREQ_KHZ;
2292  gTimingInfo.rangeEndTimes[i] -= frame0StartTime;
2293  gTimingInfo.rangeEndTimes[i] /= OBJECTDETHWA_TIMING_CPU_CLK_FREQ_KHZ;
2294  gTimingInfo.dopEndTimes[i] -= frame0StartTime;
2295  gTimingInfo.dopEndTimes[i] /= OBJECTDETHWA_TIMING_CPU_CLK_FREQ_KHZ;
2296  gTimingInfo.aoaStartTimes[i] -= frame0StartTime;
2297  gTimingInfo.aoaStartTimes[i] /= OBJECTDETHWA_TIMING_CPU_CLK_FREQ_KHZ;
2298  gTimingInfo.aoaEndTimes[i] -= frame0StartTime;
2299  gTimingInfo.aoaEndTimes[i] /= OBJECTDETHWA_TIMING_CPU_CLK_FREQ_KHZ;
2300  gTimingInfo.resEndTimes[i] -= frame0StartTime;
2301  gTimingInfo.resEndTimes[i] /= OBJECTDETHWA_TIMING_CPU_CLK_FREQ_KHZ;
2302  }
2303 
2304  DebugP_logInfo("\n");
2305  DebugP_logInfo("----DPU Timing Info (ms)----\n");
2306  DebugP_logInfo("%10s|%10s|%10s|%10s|%10s|%10s\n","FrameStart","RangeEnd","DopEnd","AoAStart","AoAEnd","ResEnd");
2307 
2308  // CacheP_wbInv((void *)&gDpc[0], sizeof(gFrameStartTimes), CacheP_TYPE_ALL);
2309  for (i = 0; i < OBJECTDETHWA_NUM_FRAME_TIMING_TO_STORE; i++)
2310  {
2311  DebugP_logInfo("%10d|%10d|%10d|%10d|%10d|%10d\n", gTimingInfo.frameStartTimes[i], gTimingInfo.rangeEndTimes[i], gTimingInfo.dopEndTimes[i], gTimingInfo.aoaStartTimes[i], gTimingInfo.aoaEndTimes[i], gTimingInfo.resEndTimes[i]);
2312  }
2313  DebugP_logInfo("-----------\n");
2314 #endif
2315 
2316 #if !defined(OBJ_DETECTION_DDMA_TEST) && defined(SOC_AWR2X44P)
2317  SemaphoreP_pend(&gDPCStateSemHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
2318 #endif
2319 
2320  /* We can be here only after complete frame processing is done, which means
2321  * processing token must be 0 and subFrameIndx also 0 */
2322  return(0);
2323 }

2454  DPC_ObjDet_EDMAChannelConfigAssist(edmaHandle,
2455  DPC_OBJDET_DPU_RANGEPROC_EDMAOUT_FMT1_PING_CH,
2456  DPC_OBJDET_DPU_RANGEPROC_EDMAOUT_FMT1_PING_SHADOW,

2463  DPC_OBJDET_DPU_RANGEPROC_EDMAOUT_FMT1_PONG_SHADOW,

2467  {
2468  {
2469 
2470  uint32_t intrIdx = 0;
2471 
2472  /* Allocate interrupt object */

2474  }
2475  }
2476 
2477  dcEstNumSamples = cfgSave->staticCfg.ADCBufData.dataProperty.numAdcSamples;
2478  if(ptrObjDetObj->commonCfg.rangeProcCfg.rangeProcChain == DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_PREVIOUS_FRAME_DC_MODE)
2479  {
2480  dcEstNumSamples *= staticCfg->numChirpsPerFrame;
2481  }
2482  /* DC Est shift and scale */

2484  &cfgSave->staticCfg.dcEstShiftScaleCfg.scale, &cfgSave->staticCfg.dcEstShiftScaleCfg.shift);
2485  if (retVal != 0)
2486  {
2487  goto exit;
2488  }
2489 
2490  interfStatsNumSamples = cfgSave->staticCfg.ADCBufData.dataProperty.numAdcSamples;
2491  if(ptrObjDetObj->commonCfg.rangeProcCfg.isReal2XEnabled)
2492  {
2493  interfStatsNumSamples *= staticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numRxAntennas;
2494  }
2495 
2496  /* Interf config */
2497  retVal = DPU_RangeProcHWA_findIntfStatsStaticParams(interfStatsNumSamples,
2498  staticCfg->intfStatsdBCfg.intfMitgMagSNRdB,
2499  &cfgSave->staticCfg.intfStatsMagShiftScaleCfg.scale, &cfgSave->staticCfg.intfStatsMagShiftScaleCfg.shift);
2500  if (retVal != 0)
2501  {
2502  goto exit;
2503  }
2504  retVal = DPU_RangeProcHWA_findIntfStatsStaticParams(interfStatsNumSamples,
2505  staticCfg->intfStatsdBCfg.intfMitgMagDiffSNRdB,
2506  &cfgSave->staticCfg.intfStatsMagDiffShiftScaleCfg.scale, &cfgSave->staticCfg.intfStatsMagDiffShiftScaleCfg.shift);
2507  if (retVal != 0)
2508  {
2509  goto exit;
2510  }
2511 
2512  uint32_t dcEstBufSize, intfThresBufSize;
2513  if((ptrObjDetObj->commonCfg.rangeProcCfg.rangeProcChain == DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_PREVIOUS_FRAME_DC_MODE)
2514  && (ptrObjDetObj->commonCfg.numSubFrames > 1U))
2515  {

2518  if(ptrObjDetObj->commonCfg.rangeProcCfg.isReal2XEnabled)

2526  dcEstBufSize = (uint32_t)staticCfg->numBandsTotal * (uint32_t)staticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numRxAntennas * sizeof(uint32_t);
2527  intfThresBufSize = dcEstBufSize; /* Interference Thresholds are stored only in 2nd RangeProcChain */
2528  }
2529 
2530  if(((ptrObjDetObj->commonCfg.rangeProcCfg.rangeProcChain == DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_PREVIOUS_FRAME_DC_MODE)
2531  && (ptrObjDetObj->commonCfg.numSubFrames > 1U))
2532  || (ptrObjDetObj->commonCfg.rangeProcCfg.rangeProcChain == DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_PREVIOUS_NTH_CHIRP_ESTIMATES_MODE))
2533  {
2534  hwRes->dcEstIVal = (uint32_t *)DPC_ObjDet_BiDirMemPoolAlloc(&ptrObjDetObj->FastRamBufObj, dcEstBufSize, (uint8_t)sizeof(uint32_t), true);
2535  if (hwRes->dcEstIVal == NULL)

2539  }
2540  (void)memset(hwRes->dcEstIVal, 0, dcEstBufSize);
2541  if(ptrObjDetObj->commonCfg.rangeProcCfg.isReal2XEnabled)
2542  {
2543  hwRes->dcEstQVal = (uint32_t *)DPC_ObjDet_BiDirMemPoolAlloc(&ptrObjDetObj->FastRamBufObj, dcEstBufSize, (uint8_t)sizeof(uint32_t), true);
2544  if (hwRes->dcEstQVal == NULL)
2545  {
2546  retVal = DPC_OBJECTDETECTION_PREPROCBUF_ERR;
2547  goto exit;
2548  }
2549  (void)memset(hwRes->dcEstQVal, 0, dcEstBufSize);
2550  }
2551  }
2552  else
2553  {
2554  hwRes->dcEstIVal = NULL;
2555  hwRes->dcEstQVal = NULL;
2556  }
2557 
2558  if(ptrObjDetObj->commonCfg.rangeProcCfg.rangeProcChain == DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_PREVIOUS_NTH_CHIRP_ESTIMATES_MODE)
2559  {
2560  hwRes->intfThresMagVal = (uint32_t *)DPC_ObjDet_BiDirMemPoolAlloc(&ptrObjDetObj->FastRamBufObj, intfThresBufSize, (uint8_t)sizeof(uint32_t), true);
2561  if (hwRes->intfThresMagVal == NULL)
2562  {
2563  retVal = DPC_OBJECTDETECTION_PREPROCBUF_ERR;

2565  }
2566 
2567  hwRes->intfThresMagDiffVal = (uint32_t *)DPC_ObjDet_BiDirMemPoolAlloc(&ptrObjDetObj->FastRamBufObj, intfThresBufSize, (uint8_t)sizeof(uint32_t), true);
2568  if (hwRes->intfThresMagDiffVal == NULL)
2569  {
2570  retVal = DPC_OBJECTDETECTION_PREPROCBUF_ERR;
2571  goto exit;
2572  }
2573 
2574  (void)memset(hwRes->intfThresMagVal, 0, intfThresBufSize);
2575  (void)memset(hwRes->intfThresMagDiffVal, 0, intfThresBufSize);
2576  }
2577 
2578  /* In this case HWA hardware trigger source is equal to HWA param index value*/
2579  hwaCfg->dataInputMode = DPU_RangeProcHWA_InputMode_ISOLATED;
2580 
2581 #ifdef DPC_USE_SYMMETRIC_WINDOW_RANGE_DPU
2582  hwaCfg->hwaWinSym = HWA_FFT_WINDOW_SYMMETRIC;
2583 #else
2584  hwaCfg->hwaWinSym = HWA_FFT_WINDOW_NONSYMMETRIC;
2585 #endif
2586  hwaCfg->hwaWinRamOffset = (uint16_t) *windowOffset;
2587  if ((hwaCfg->hwaWinRamOffset + winGenLen) > DPC_OBJDET_HWA_MAX_WINDOW_RAM_SIZE_IN_SAMPLES)
2588  {
2589  retVal = DPC_OBJECTDETECTION_ENOMEM_HWA_WINDOW_RAM;
2590  goto exit;
2591  }
2592  *windowOffset += winGenLen;
2593 
2594  hwaCfg->numParamSet = DPU_RANGEPROCHWADDMA_NUM_HWA_PARAM_SETS + staticCfg->compressionCfg.bfpCompExtraParamSets;
2595  /* Twice the value of rangeProcChain equals the number of paramsets saved compared to the default mode */
2596  hwaCfg->numParamSet -= ptrObjDetObj->commonCfg.rangeProcCfg.rangeProcChain * 2U;
2597  hwaCfg->paramSetStartIdx = DPC_OBJDET_DPU_RANGEPROC_PARAMSET_START_IDX;
2598 
2599  retVal = DPU_RangeProcHWA_config(dpuHandle, cfgSave);
2600  if (retVal != 0)
2601  {
2602  goto exit;
2603  }
2604 
2605  /* store configuration for use in intra-sub-frame processing and
2606  * inter-sub-frame switching, although window will need to be regenerated and
2607  * dc range sig should not be reset. */
2608  cfgSave->staticCfg.resetDcRangeSigMeanBuffer = 0;
2609 
2610  /* report scratch usage */
2611  *CoreLocalRamScratchUsage = cfgSave->staticCfg.windowSize;
2612 exit:
2613 
2614  return retVal;
2615 }

3156  /* Assign the detection matrix */

3159  }

3200  {

3325 static int32_t DPC_ObjDet_preStartConfig(SubFrameObj *obj,
3326  DPC_ObjectDetection_PreStartCommonCfg *commonCfg,
3327  DPC_ObjectDetection_StaticCfg *staticCfg,
3328  EDMA_Handle edmaHandle[EDMA_NUM_CC],
3329  BiDirMemPoolObj *L3ramObj,
3330  MemPoolObj *CoreLocalRamObj,
3331  uint32_t *hwaMemBankAddr,
3332  uint16_t hwaMemBankSize,
3333  uint32_t *L3RamUsage,
3334  uint32_t *CoreLocalRamUsage,
3335  ObjDetObj *ptrObjDetObj)
3336 {
3337  int32_t retVal = 0;
3338  DPIF_RadarCube radarCube;
3339  DPIF_DetMatrix detMatrix;
3340  uint32_t hwaWindowOffset;
3341  uint32_t rangeCoreLocalRamScratchUsage,
3342  dopplerCoreLocalRamScratchUsage;
3343  void *CoreLocalScratchStartPoolAddr;
3344  float achievedCompressionRatio;
3345  uint32_t outputBytesPerBlock, inputBytesPerBlock;
3346  uint32_t radarCubeDecompressedSizeInBytes;
3347  void *CoreLocalScratchStartPoolAddrNextDPU = NULL;
3348  void *l3RamStartPoolAddrNextDPU = NULL;
3349  float temp;
3350 #ifdef SUBSYS_DSS
3351  float radConversionFactor;
3352  radConversionFactor = PI_/180.0f;
3353 #endif
3354 
3355  /* save configs to object. We need to pass this stored config (instead of
3356  the input arguments to this function which will be in stack) to
3357  the DPU config functions inside of this function because the DPUs
3358  have pointers to dynamic configurations which are later going to be
3359  reused during re-configuration (intra sub-frame or inter sub-frame)
3360  */
3361  obj->staticCfg = *staticCfg;
3362 
3363  hwaWindowOffset = DPC_OBJDET_HWA_WINDOW_RAM_OFFSET;
3364 
3365  /* derived config */
3366  obj->log2NumDopplerBins = mathUtils_floorLog2(staticCfg->numDopplerBins);
3367 
3368  DPC_ObjDet_BiDirMemPoolResetTop(L3ramObj);
3369  DPC_ObjDet_MemPoolReset(CoreLocalRamObj);
3370 
3371  /* L3 allocations */
3372  /* L3 - radar cube */
3373  /* Input and output samples out of the rangeproc/compression DPU */
3374  if(staticCfg->compressionCfg.compressionMethod==HWA_COMPRESS_METHOD_BFP)
3375  {
3376  inputBytesPerBlock = 4U * (uint32_t)staticCfg->compressionCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock;
3377  }
3378  else
3379  {
3380  inputBytesPerBlock = 4U * (uint32_t)staticCfg->compressionCfg.numRxAntennaPerBlock * (uint32_t)staticCfg->compressionCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock;
3381  }
3382  temp = (((staticCfg->compressionCfg.compressionRatio * (float)inputBytesPerBlock) + 3.99F) / 4.0F);
3383  outputBytesPerBlock = (uint32_t)temp * 4U; /* Word aligned */
3384  achievedCompressionRatio = (float) outputBytesPerBlock / (float) inputBytesPerBlock;
3385 
3386  radarCubeDecompressedSizeInBytes = (uint32_t)staticCfg->numRangeBins * (uint32_t)staticCfg->numChirps *
3387  (uint32_t)staticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numRxAntennas * sizeof(cmplx16ReIm_t);
3388  temp = (float) radarCubeDecompressedSizeInBytes * achievedCompressionRatio;
3389  radarCube.dataSize = (uint32_t)temp;
3390  radarCube.data = DPC_ObjDet_BiDirMemPoolAlloc(L3ramObj, radarCube.dataSize,
3391  (uint8_t)DPC_OBJDET_RADAR_CUBE_DATABUF_BYTE_ALIGNMENT, false);
3392 
3393  if (radarCube.data == NULL)
3394  {
3395  retVal = DPC_OBJECTDETECTION_ENOMEM__L3_RAM_RADAR_CUBE;
3396  goto exit;
3397  }
3398  radarCube.datafmt = DPIF_RADARCUBE_FORMAT_2;
3399 
3400  if (staticCfg->isSumTxEnabled)
3401  {
3402  /* L3 - detection matrix */
3403  detMatrix.dataSize = (uint32_t)staticCfg->numRangeBins * ((uint32_t)staticCfg->numDopplerBins / (uint32_t)staticCfg->numBandsTotal) * sizeof(uint16_t);
3404  detMatrix.data = DPC_ObjDet_BiDirMemPoolAlloc(L3ramObj, detMatrix.dataSize,
3405  (uint8_t)DPC_OBJDET_DET_MATRIX_DATABUF_BYTE_ALIGNMENT, false);
3406  if (detMatrix.data == NULL)
3407  {
3408  retVal = DPC_OBJECTDETECTION_ENOMEM__L3_RAM_DET_MATRIX;
3409  goto exit;
3410  }
3411  detMatrix.datafmt = DPIF_DETMATRIX_FORMAT_1;
3412  }
3413 
3414  /* Remember pool position */
3415  CoreLocalScratchStartPoolAddr = DPC_ObjDet_MemPoolGet(CoreLocalRamObj);
3416 
3417  retVal = DPC_ObjDet_rangeConfig(obj->dpuRangeObj, &obj->staticCfg,
3418  edmaHandle[DPC_OBJDET_DPU_RANGEPROC_EDMA_INST_ID],
3419  &radarCube, CoreLocalRamObj, L3ramObj, &hwaWindowOffset,
3420  &rangeCoreLocalRamScratchUsage, &obj->dpuCfg.rangeCfg,
3421  ptrObjDetObj);
3422  if (retVal != 0)
3423  {
3424  goto exit;
3425  }
3426 
3427  if (obj->staticCfg.rangeCfarCfg.cfg.isEnabled)
3428  {
3429  /* allocating range cfar resources after range DPU resource allocation because of the following reasons:
3430  * 1. range DPU resources + range cfar resources are mostly less than dppler DPU resources size; so,
3431  * instead of allocating at the end of doppler dpu, allocating here, will save around 4-5KB of L2RAM.
3432  */
3433  retVal = DPC_ObjDet_rangeCfarConfig(obj->dpuRangeCfarObj, &obj->staticCfg,
3434  edmaHandle[DPC_OBJDET_DPU_RANGECFARPROC_EDMA_INST_ID],
3435  &detMatrix,
3436  CoreLocalRamObj,
3437  L3ramObj,
3438  CoreLocalScratchStartPoolAddrNextDPU,
3439  l3RamStartPoolAddrNextDPU,
3440  &obj->dpuCfg.rangeCfarCfg,
3441  ptrObjDetObj);
3442  if (retVal != 0)
3443  {
3444  goto exit;
3445  }
3446  }
3447 
3448  /* Rewind to the scratch beginning */
3449  DPC_ObjDet_MemPoolSet(CoreLocalRamObj, CoreLocalScratchStartPoolAddr);
3450  CoreLocalScratchStartPoolAddrNextDPU = CoreLocalScratchStartPoolAddr;
3451  l3RamStartPoolAddrNextDPU = DPC_ObjDet_BiDirMemPoolGetTop(L3ramObj);
3452 
3453  retVal = DPC_ObjDet_dopplerConfig(obj, obj->dpuDopplerObj, &obj->staticCfg,
3454  obj->log2NumDopplerBins,
3455  commonCfg->antennaCalibParams,
3456  edmaHandle[DPC_OBJDET_DPU_DOPPLERPROC_EDMA_INST_ID],
3457  radarCubeDecompressedSizeInBytes,
3458  &radarCube, &detMatrix, CoreLocalRamObj, L3ramObj,
3459  CoreLocalScratchStartPoolAddr,
3460  (volatile void *)CoreLocalScratchStartPoolAddrNextDPU,
3461  (volatile void *)l3RamStartPoolAddrNextDPU, &hwaWindowOffset,
3462  &dopplerCoreLocalRamScratchUsage, &obj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg,
3463  ptrObjDetObj);
3464  if (retVal != 0)
3465  {
3466  goto exit;
3467  }
3468 
3469  /* Allocate the EDMA channel to copy the object found in both doppler and range cfar list from L3 to L2. */
3470  DPC_ObjDet_EDMAChannelConfigAssist(edmaHandle[DPC_OBJDET_DPU_DOPPLERPROC_EDMA_INST_ID],
3471  EDMA_OBJECTDETECTIONDPC_INTERSECT_DETOBJS,
3472  EDMA_OBJECTDETECTIONDPC_INTERSECT_DETOBJS_SHADOW,
3473  0,
3474  &ptrObjDetObj->edmaDetObjs);
3475 
3476  retVal = DPC_ObjectDetection_configEdmaDetObjsOut(edmaHandle[DPC_OBJDET_DPU_DOPPLERPROC_EDMA_INST_ID],
3477  &obj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.hwRes,
3478  &ptrObjDetObj->edmaDetObjs);
3479  if(retVal != 0)
3480  {
3481  goto exit;
3482  }
3483 
3484 #ifdef SUBSYS_DSS
3485  /* Sin values of FOV */
3486  obj->aoaFovSinVal.minAzimuthSinVal = sinsp(radConversionFactor * obj->staticCfg.aoaFovCfg.minAzimuthDeg);
3487  obj->aoaFovSinVal.maxAzimuthSinVal = sinsp(radConversionFactor * obj->staticCfg.aoaFovCfg.maxAzimuthDeg);
3488  obj->aoaFovSinVal.minElevationSinVal = sinsp(radConversionFactor * obj->staticCfg.aoaFovCfg.minElevationDeg);
3489  obj->aoaFovSinVal.maxElevationSinVal = sinsp(radConversionFactor * obj->staticCfg.aoaFovCfg.maxElevationDeg);
3490 #endif
3491 
3492  /* Report RAM usage */
3493  *CoreLocalRamUsage = DPC_ObjDet_MemPoolGetMaxUsage(CoreLocalRamObj);
3494  *L3RamUsage = DPC_ObjDet_BiDirMemPoolGetMaxUsage(L3ramObj);
3495 
3496 exit:
3497  return retVal;
3498 }

3518 int32_t DPC_ObjectDetection_ioctl(
3519  DPM_DPCHandle handle,
3520  uint32_t cmd,
3521  void* arg,
3522  uint32_t argLen)
3523 {
3524  ObjDetObj *objDetObj;
3525  SubFrameObj *subFrmObj;
3526  int32_t retVal = 0;
3527 
3528  /* Get the DSS MCB: */
3529  objDetObj = (ObjDetObj *) handle;
3530  DebugP_assert(objDetObj != NULL);
3531 
3532  /* Process the commands. Process non sub-frame specific ones first
3533  * so the sub-frame specific ones can share some code. */
3534  if (cmd == DPC_OBJDET_IOCTL__TRIGGER_FRAME)
3535  {
3536  DPC_ObjectDetection_frameStart(handle);
3537  }
3538  else if (cmd == DPC_OBJDET_IOCTL__STATIC_PRE_START_COMMON_CFG)
3539  {
3540  DPC_ObjectDetection_PreStartCommonCfg *cfg;
3541 
3542  DebugP_assert(argLen == sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_PreStartCommonCfg));
3543 
3544  cfg = (DPC_ObjectDetection_PreStartCommonCfg*)arg;
3545 
3546  objDetObj->commonCfg = *cfg;
3547  objDetObj->isCommonCfgReceived = true;
3548 
3549  retVal = DPC_ObjDet_preStartCommonConfig(objDetObj,
3550  cfg,
3551  &objDetObj->L3RamObj);
3552  if (retVal != 0)
3553  {
3554  goto exit;
3555  }
3556 
3557 #if defined(SOC_AWR2X44P)
3558  DPC_ObjectDetection_ElevEstCommonCfg elevEstCommonCfg;
3559  elevEstCommonCfg.numSubFrames = cfg->numSubFrames;
3560  (void)memcpy(elevEstCommonCfg.antennaCalibParams, cfg->antennaCalibParams, sizeof(elevEstCommonCfg.antennaCalibParams));
3561  (void)memcpy(elevEstCommonCfg.antennaGeometryCfg, cfg->antennaGeometryCfg, sizeof(elevEstCommonCfg.antennaGeometryCfg));
3562  elevEstCommonCfg.antennaSpacing = cfg->antennaSpacing;
3563  elevEstCommonCfg.zeroInsrtMaskCfg = cfg->zeroInsrtMaskCfg;
3564  elevEstCommonCfg.result = (DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResult *)((uint32_t)SOC_virtToPhy((void*)&gObjDetObj.executeResult));
3565 
3566  /* Copy elevEstCommonCfg to message buffer to send it to MSS */
3567  *(DPC_ObjectDetection_ElevEstCommonCfg *) arg = elevEstCommonCfg;
3568 #endif
3569 
3570  DebugP_logInfo("ObjDet DPC: Pre-start Common Config IOCTL processed\n");
3571  }
3572  else if (cmd == DPC_OBJDET_IOCTL__DYNAMIC_EXECUTE_RESULT_EXPORTED)
3573  {
3574 #ifdef INCLUDE_DPM
3575  DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResultExportedInfo *inp;
3576  volatile uint32_t startTime;
3577 
3578  startTime = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
3579 
3580  DebugP_assert(argLen == sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResultExportedInfo));
3581 
3582  inp = (DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResultExportedInfo *)arg;
3583 
3584  /* input sub-frame index must match current sub-frame index */
3585  DebugP_assert(inp->subFrameIdx == objDetObj->subFrameIndx);
3586 
3587  /* Increment the subframe index to get the next subrame object */
3588  if (objDetObj->commonCfg.numSubFrames > 1)
3589  {
3590  /* Next sub-frame */
3591  objDetObj->subFrameIndx++;
3592  if (objDetObj->subFrameIndx == objDetObj->commonCfg.numSubFrames)
3593  {
3594  objDetObj->subFrameIndx = 0;
3595  }
3596  }
3597  objDetObj->stats.subFramePreparationCycles =
3598  CycleCounterP_getCount32() - startTime;
3599 
3600  /* mark end of processing of the frame/sub-frame by the DPC and the app */
3601  objDetObj->interSubFrameProcToken--;
3602 
3603 #ifdef OBJECTDETHWA_PRINT_DPC_TIMING_INFO
3604  gTimingInfo.resEndTimes[gTimingInfo.resEndCnt % OBJECTDETHWA_NUM_FRAME_TIMING_TO_STORE] = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
3605  gTimingInfo.resEndCnt++;
3606 #endif
3607  objDetObj->numTimesResultExported++;
3608 
3609  /* Perform DPM_notifyExecute only if the next frame was received before while
3610  the processing of the previous frame was not complete, i.e., the frame start
3611  ISR for the next frame was entered before the result exported ioctl was received
3612  for the previous frame. Otherwise, perform DPM_notifyExecute in the frame start
3613  ISR. */
3614  if (objDetObj->numTimesResultExported == objDetObj->stats.subframeStartIntCounter - 1)
3615  {
3616  DebugP_assert(DPM_notifyExecute(objDetObj->dpmHandle, handle) == 0);
3617  }
3618  else
3619  {
3620  // Do Nothing
3621  }
3622 #endif
3623  }
3624  else
3625  {
3626  uint8_t subFrameNum;
3627 
3628  /* First argument is sub-frame number */
3629  DebugP_assert(arg != NULL);
3630  subFrameNum = *(uint8_t *)arg;
3631  subFrmObj = &objDetObj->subFrameObj[subFrameNum];
3632 
3633  switch (cmd)
3634  {
3635  /* Related to pre-start configuration */
3636  case DPC_OBJDET_IOCTL__STATIC_PRE_START_CFG:
3637  {
3638  DPC_ObjectDetection_PreStartCfg *cfg;
3639  DPC_ObjectDetection_DPC_IOCTL_preStartCfg_memUsage *memUsage;
3640 #if defined(SOC_AWR2X44P)
3641  DPC_ObjectDetection_ElevEstSubframeCfg elevEstSubframeCfg;
3642  float radConversionFactor;
3643  radConversionFactor = PI_/180.0f;
3644 #endif
3645 
3646  /* Pre-start common config must be received before pre-start configs
3647  * are received. */
3648  if (objDetObj->isCommonCfgReceived == false)
3649  {
3650  retVal = DPC_OBJECTDETECTION_PRE_START_CONFIG_BEFORE_PRE_START_COMMON_CONFIG;
3651  goto exit;
3652  }
3653 
3654  DebugP_assert(argLen == sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_PreStartCfg));
3655 
3656  cfg = (DPC_ObjectDetection_PreStartCfg*)arg;
3657  memUsage = &cfg->memUsage;
3658  memUsage->L3RamTotal = objDetObj->L3RamObj.cfg.size;
3659  memUsage->CoreLocalRamTotal = objDetObj->CoreLocalRamObj.cfg.size;
3660  retVal = DPC_ObjDet_preStartConfig(subFrmObj,
3661  &objDetObj->commonCfg, &cfg->staticCfg,
3662  &objDetObj->edmaHandle[0],
3663  &objDetObj->L3RamObj,
3664  &objDetObj->CoreLocalRamObj,
3665  &objDetObj->hwaMemBankAddr[0],
3666  objDetObj->hwaMemBankSize,
3667  &memUsage->L3RamUsage,
3668  &memUsage->CoreLocalRamUsage,
3669  objDetObj);
3670  if (retVal != 0)
3671  {
3672  goto exit;
3673  }
3674 
3675 #if defined(SOC_AWR2X44P)
3676  /* Populate the configs requirred for AoA estimation */
3677  elevEstSubframeCfg.numAzimFFTBins = subFrmObj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.staticCfg.numAzimFFTBins;
3678  elevEstSubframeCfg.numDopplerBins = subFrmObj->staticCfg.numDopplerBins;
3679  elevEstSubframeCfg.rangeStep = subFrmObj->staticCfg.rangeStep;
3680  elevEstSubframeCfg.dopplerStep = subFrmObj->staticCfg.dopplerStep;
3681 
3682  /* Sin values of FOV */
3683  elevEstSubframeCfg.aoaFovSinVal.minAzimuthDeg = (float)sin((double)radConversionFactor * (double)subFrmObj->staticCfg.aoaFovCfg.minAzimuthDeg);
3684  elevEstSubframeCfg.aoaFovSinVal.maxAzimuthDeg = (float)sin((double)radConversionFactor * (double)subFrmObj->staticCfg.aoaFovCfg.maxAzimuthDeg);
3685  elevEstSubframeCfg.aoaFovSinVal.minElevationDeg = (float)sin((double)radConversionFactor * (double)subFrmObj->staticCfg.aoaFovCfg.minElevationDeg);
3686  elevEstSubframeCfg.aoaFovSinVal.maxElevationDeg = (float)sin((double)radConversionFactor * (double)subFrmObj->staticCfg.aoaFovCfg.maxElevationDeg);
3687 
3688  /* Copy elevEstSubframeCfg to message buffer to send it to MSS */
3689  *(DPC_ObjectDetection_ElevEstSubframeCfg *)arg = elevEstSubframeCfg;
3690 #endif
3691  DebugP_logInfo("ObjDet DPC: Pre-start Config IOCTL processed (subFrameIndx = %d)\n", subFrameNum);
3692  break;
3693  }
3694 
3695  default:
3696  {
3697  /* Error: This is an unsupported command */
3698  retVal = DPC_OBJECTDETECTION_EINVAL__COMMAND;
3699  break;
3700  }
3701  }
3702  }
3703 
3704 exit:
3705  return retVal;
3706 }

3732 DPM_DPCHandle DPC_ObjectDetection_init(
3733 #ifdef INCLUDE_DPM
3734  DPM_Handle dpmHandle,
3735  DPM_InitCfg* ptrInitCfg,
3736 #else
3737  DPC_ObjectDetection_InitParams* dpcInitParams,
3738 #endif
3739 
3740  int32_t *errCode)
3741 {
3742  uint32_t i;
3743  ObjDetObj *objDetObj = NULL;
3744 #ifdef INCLUDE_DPM
3745  DPC_ObjectDetection_InitParams *dpcInitParams;
3746 #endif
3747  HWA_MemInfo hwaMemInfo;
3748 
3749  *errCode = 0;
3750 
3751 #ifdef INCLUDE_DPM
3752  if ((ptrInitCfg == NULL) || (ptrInitCfg->arg == NULL))
3753 #else
3754  if (dpcInitParams == NULL)
3755 #endif
3756  {
3757  *errCode = DPC_OBJECTDETECTION_EINVAL;
3758  goto exit;
3759  }
3760 
3761 #ifdef INCLUDE_DPM
3762  if (ptrInitCfg->argSize != sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_InitParams))
3763  {
3764  *errCode = DPC_OBJECTDETECTION_EINVAL__INIT_CFG_ARGSIZE;
3765  goto exit;
3766  }
3767 
3768  dpcInitParams = (DPC_ObjectDetection_InitParams *) ptrInitCfg->arg;
3769 #endif
3770 
3771  objDetObj = &gObjDetObj;
3772 
3773  /* Initialize memory */
3774  (void)memset((void *)objDetObj, 0, sizeof(ObjDetObj));
3775 
3776 #ifdef INCLUDE_DPM
3777  /* Copy over the DPM configuration: */
3778  (void)memcpy ((void*)&objDetObj->dpmInitCfg, (void*)ptrInitCfg, sizeof(DPM_InitCfg));
3779 
3780  objDetObj->dpmHandle = dpmHandle;
3781 #endif
3782 
3783  objDetObj->hwaHandle = dpcInitParams->hwaHandle;
3784  objDetObj->L3RamObj.cfg = dpcInitParams->L3ramCfg;
3785  objDetObj->CoreLocalRamObj.cfg = dpcInitParams->CoreLocalRamCfg;
3786  DPC_ObjDet_BiDirMemPoolReset(&objDetObj->L3RamObj);
3787 
3788  for(i = 0; i < (uint32_t)EDMA_NUM_CC; i++)
3789  {
3790  objDetObj->edmaHandle[i] = dpcInitParams->edmaHandle[i];
3791  }
3792 
3793  objDetObj->processCallBackCfg = dpcInitParams->processCallBackCfg;
3794 
3795 #ifndef INCLUDE_DPM
3796  /* Create Semaphore to trigger DPC execution on frame start */
3797  *errCode = SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&objDetObj->dpcExecSemHandle, 0);
3798  if (*errCode != 0)
3799  {
3800  goto exit;
3801  }
3802 #endif
3803 
3804  /* Set HWA bank memory address */
3805  *errCode = HWA_getHWAMemInfo(dpcInitParams->hwaHandle, &hwaMemInfo);
3806  if (*errCode != 0)
3807  {
3808  goto exit;
3809  }
3810 
3811  objDetObj->hwaMemBankSize = hwaMemInfo.bankSize;
3812 
3813  for (i = 0; i < hwaMemInfo.numBanks; i++)
3814  {
3815  objDetObj->hwaMemBankAddr[i] = hwaMemInfo.baseAddress +
3816  i * hwaMemInfo.bankSize;
3817  }
3818 
3819  /* Initialize M4 RAM Buffer Object */
3820  objDetObj->FastRamBufObj.cfg.addr = &gFastRamBuffer[0U];
3821  objDetObj->FastRamBufObj.cfg.size = sizeof(gFastRamBuffer);
3822  objDetObj->FastRamBufObj.cfg.endSize = sizeof(gFastRamBuffer);
3823  DPC_ObjDet_BiDirMemPoolReset(&objDetObj->FastRamBufObj);
3824 
3825 exit:
3826 
3827  if(*errCode != 0)
3828  {
3829  if(objDetObj != NULL)
3830  {
3831 
3832  objDetObj = NULL;
3833  }
3834  }
3835 
3836  return ((DPM_DPCHandle)objDetObj);
3837 }
